"""
Shopping Cart & Shipping Options Simulator
-------------------------------------------
Demonstrates:
  - Cart with add/remove/update operations
  - Shipping option selection
  - Out-of-stock item detection and removal
  - Order summary with totals
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional


# ── Shipping Options ─────────────────────────────────────────────

class ShippingMethod(Enum):
    STANDARD = ("Standard Shipping (5-7 business days)", 4.99)
    EXPRESS = ("Express Shipping (2-3 business days)", 9.99)
    OVERNIGHT = ("Overnight Shipping (1 business day)", 19.99)
    FREE = ("Free Shipping (7-10 business days)", 0.00)

    def __init__(self, description: str, cost: float):
        self.description = description
        self.cost = cost


# ── Cart Item ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class CartItem:
    name: str
    price: float
    quantity: int
    in_stock: bool = True

    @property
    def subtotal(self) -> float:
        return self.price * self.quantity


# ── Shopping Cart ────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class ShoppingCart:
    items: list[CartItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    shipping: Optional[ShippingMethod] = None

    # ── Item operations ──

    def add_item(self, item: CartItem):
        # Merge if same product already in cart
        for existing in self.items:
            if existing.name == item.name:
                existing.quantity += item.quantity
                print(f"  ✔ Updated '{item.name}' quantity to {existing.quantity}")
                return
        self.items.append(item)
        print(f"  ✔ Added '{item.name}' (x{item.quantity}) — ${item.price:.2f} each")

    def remove_item(self, name: str):
        for item in self.items:
            if item.name == name:
                self.items.remove(item)
                print(f"  ✖ Removed '{name}' from cart")
                return
        print(f"  ⚠ Item '{name}' not found in cart")

    def update_quantity(self, name: str, quantity: int):
        for item in self.items:
            if item.name == name:
                old_qty = item.quantity
                item.quantity = quantity
                print(f"  ✔ Updated '{name}' quantity: {old_qty} → {quantity}")
                return
        print(f"  ⚠ Item '{name}' not found in cart")

    # ── Out-of-stock handling ──

    def remove_out_of_stock(self):
        out_of_stock = [item for item in self.items if not item.in_stock]
        if not out_of_stock:
            print("  ✔ All items are in stock!")
            return
        for item in out_of_stock:
            print(f"  ✖ Removing out-of-stock item: '{item.name}'")
            self.items.remove(item)
        print(f"  → Removed {len(out_of_stock)} out-of-stock item(s)")

    # ── Shipping ──

    def select_shipping(self, method: ShippingMethod):
        self.shipping = method
        print(f"  ✔ Selected: {method.description} — ${method.cost:.2f}")

    @staticmethod
    def show_shipping_options():
        print("\n  Available Shipping Options:")
        print("  " + "─" * 50)
        for i, method in enumerate(ShippingMethod, 1):
            print(f"    {i}. {method.description:<45} ${method.cost:>6.2f}")

    # ── Totals & Summary ──

    @property
    def items_total(self) -> float:
        return sum(item.subtotal for item in self.items)

    @property
    def shipping_cost(self) -> float:
        return self.shipping.cost if self.shipping else 0.0

    @property
    def order_total(self) -> float:
        return self.items_total + self.shipping_cost

    def show_summary(self):
        print("\n  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
        print("  ║                    ORDER SUMMARY                        ║")
        print("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣")

        if not self.items:
            print("  ║  Cart is empty!                                         ║")
        else:
            for item in self.items:
                stock = "✔" if item.in_stock else "✖ OUT OF STOCK"
                line = f"  {item.name} (x{item.quantity})"
                print(f"  ║ {line:<38} ${item.subtotal:>7.2f}  {stock:<6} ║")

        print("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣")
        print(f"  ║  {'Items Subtotal:':<40} ${self.items_total:>7.2f}    ║")

        if self.shipping:
            print(f"  ║  {self.shipping.description:<40} ${self.shipping_cost:>7.2f}    ║")
        else:
            print(f"  ║  {'Shipping: (not selected)':<40} {'---':>10}    ║")

        print("  ╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣")
        print(f"  ║  {'ORDER TOTAL:':<40} ${self.order_total:>7.2f}    ║")
        print("  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")


# ── Run Simulation ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    cart = ShoppingCart()

    # Step 1: Add items to cart
    print("\n📦 Step 1: Adding items to cart...")
    cart.add_item(CartItem(name="Wireless Headphones", price=59.99, quantity=1, in_stock=True))
    cart.add_item(CartItem(name="USB-C Charging Cable", price=12.99, quantity=2, in_stock=True))
    cart.add_item(CartItem(name="Phone Case (Limited Ed.)", price=29.99, quantity=1, in_stock=False))
    cart.add_item(CartItem(name="Screen Protector", price=8.99, quantity=3, in_stock=True))

    # Step 2: Show initial cart
    print("\n📋 Step 2: Reviewing cart...")
    cart.show_summary()

    # Step 3: Browse shipping options
    print("\n🚚 Step 3: Browsing shipping options...")
    cart.show_shipping_options()

    # Step 4: Select a shipping method
    print("\n🚚 Step 4: Selecting shipping method...")
    cart.select_shipping(ShippingMethod.EXPRESS)

    # Step 5: Remove out-of-stock items
    print("\n🔍 Step 5: Checking for out-of-stock items...")
    cart.remove_out_of_stock()

    # Step 6: Update an item quantity
    print("\n✏️  Step 6: Updating item quantity...")
    cart.update_quantity("USB-C Charging Cable", 1)

    # Step 7: Show final summary
    print("\n📋 Step 7: Final order summary...")
    cart.show_summary()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
